title: Better Friends
description: Make the new friends menu feel like it belongs.
body:
![Image of the main menu without the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b15d22b29328978e84889555e9be78abe993250a_0.webp)

To me the new main menu looked very modded, so I made a replacement that feels closer to the older versions. It also fixes the pause menu.

![Image of the main menu with the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b349efc2a306cc6d6701279c370c88048d378038_0.webp)
